domains.detailed_narrative:
With Aries ascendant (Mesha Lagna), you possess a pioneering spirit, courage, and initiative. Mars as your ascendant lord gives you dynamic energy and competitive drive. You prefer to lead rather than follow and approach life with directness and enthusiasm. Physical activity and challenges appeal to your nature.
